name: Assault on the Kolkar
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The Kolkar think they are strong, but we laugh at them!  We laugh and we kill them!  You kill them too.  Show me you can kill Kolkar like we do. Head north and slay them all!
narrative.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram. Kill 12 Kolkar Centaurs, 12 Kolkar Scouts and 6 Kolkar Maulers, then return to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Kolkar fear you now! I hope you laughed when you killed them. It is better to laugh when you kill, so the enemy can see he is weak.
narrative.requestItemsText: Are you afraid of the Kolkar? Why do you not kill them? Maybe you forgot how to kill. Hurry and kill Kolkar before they are dead!

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 32 to 42, 16,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Brutal Politics
quests.objectiveText: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.

quests.name: Assault on the Kolkar
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram.

quests.name: Broken Tears
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.

quests.name: Gizmo for Warug
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring an Advanced Target Dummy to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Khan Shaka
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Khan Hratha
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
